# Decision 001

**Date:** 2026-08-10

**Status:** Accepted

**Category:** Legal / Project Management

| Category               | Use for                                                                       |
| ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Product**            | Decisions about what Yek is, who it's for, and what the product should do     |
| **Scope**              | Decisions about what is included/excluded from the project                    |
| **Requirements**       | Decisions about Functional or Non-Functional Requirements                     |
| **Architecture**       | Major decisions about how the application/data/system is structured           |
| **Technology**         | Frameworks, programming languages, development tools, and technical platforms |
| **Data**               | JSON structure, vocabulary IDs, databases, data organization, etc.            |
| **UI/UX**              | Wireframes, mockups, navigation, interaction, visual design                   |
| **Content**            | Vocabulary, categories, translations, learning material                       |
| **Audio/Media**        | Audio recording, file formats, naming, storage, media assets                  |
| **Project Management** | Methodology, Sprints, Jira, estimation, documentation processes               |
| **Documentation**      | PRD, Charter, Scope Statement, Vision, Decision Log, etc.                     |
| **Portfolio**          | Decisions related to publicly displaying the project/PM work                  |
| **Business**           | Business model, target market, product strategy, etc.                         |
| **Monetization**       | Ads, subscriptions, premium features, pricing, revenue                        |
| **Marketing**          | Advertising, promotion, user acquisition, analytics related to marketing      |
| **Legal/Licensing**    | Copyright, licenses, contracts, permissions, intellectual property            |
| **Security/Privacy**   | Accounts, data collection, privacy, security, etc.                            |
| **Financial**          | Budget, expenses, consulting costs, financial planning                        |
| **Stakeholder**        | Decisions involving contributors, advisors, users, or other stakeholders      |
